ResearchProjectDef.label: basic gravtech
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build a gravship around an inspected grav engine. Unlocks gravship hull, the pilot console, thrusters, fuel tanks, grav anchors and field extenders.

ResearchProjectDef.label: orbital tech
ResearchProjectDef.description: Survive in vacuum. Unlocks vacsuits, vac barriers, oxygen pumps and the orbital scanner.

ResearchProjectDef.label: standard gravtech
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build larger gravships. Unlocks large thrusters and fuel tanks.

ResearchProjectDef.label: advanced gravtech
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build advanced gravship systems. Unlocks the pilot assistant, gravlite panels, signal jammer and gravcore power cell.
